revision: run 2 (spec gate round 1 remediation); run 1 kept as backend-apis.run1.json
note: There is no endpoint and no event (Story RWB-E1-069 v1, section 12). The contracts below are the non-HTTP interfaces this story publishes. Migration numbers are assigned at merge (D-RUN-07).

contents: 3 helper functions, CREATE OR REPLACE: ace_to_boolean and ace_mask_value as ACE Source Views v1; ace_to_date to the BR6 behaviour table in spec SPEC-002 (not the source body, DG-L23)
16 Section A views, verbatim from ACE Source Views v1 lines 94-452, qualifier recovery. -> ${recoverySchema}.
Section A grant block, spec SPEC-004 steps 1-10; no statement on schema public
14 Section B views, verbatim from ACE Source Views v1 lines 461-711
Full owner sequence for the 14 views: transient CREATE, per-view REVOKE, ALTER OWNER, GRANT SELECT, REVOKE CREATE (spec SPEC-004 steps 5-9)
contracts.precondition: RWB-ACE-001 deployed with its grants (DL43); merged only after it is deployed (DG-L20)

contracts.objects: 30 views ${recoverySchema}.v_ace_* (Story RWB-E1-069 v1, section 11), security_invoker not set
contracts.fields: 304 fields, DF-ACE-001..304. Columns are cited from ACE Source Views v1 and not copied here.
contracts.dataClassification: Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v4: 250 personal fields, 12 Restricted (spec SPEC-019). Identity number exposed only as id_no_masked and id_no_last4. Display masking RWB-E1-037; read audit RWB-E1-016.

grantees.ace_view_owner: owns the 30 views; no USAGE or CREATE on schema recovery after each file; no EXECUTE on the helpers; no privilege on any other recovery relation. ACE-side: USAGE on public and SELECT on the 21 Tier 1 and 14 Tier 2 tables, granted by the ACE DBA (precondition P4(d)), not by these files
grantees.recovery_svc: USAGE on recovery; SELECT on each v_ace_* view; EXECUTE on the 3 helper functions; nothing in public
grantees.PUBLIC: nothing on recovery tables or views; no EXECUTE on the helper functions
grantees.migrationAccount: precondition P4: USAGE on public, member of ace_view_owner, owner of schema recovery (or may grant CREATE on it)

shape.sectionA: list of the 16 Section A names, Story RWB-E1-069 v1 section 11 order
shape.sectionB: list of the 14 Section B names

contracts.validation: name pattern ^v_ace_[a-z0-9_]+$, unique across both lists, counts 16 and 14; migration-folder rules in spec SPEC-013
contracts.owner: RWB-E1-069 for this key only; the rest of the file and the loader belong to RWB-TE-001 (D-RCV-37)

contracts.qualifierSeam: SEAM-E044-01 is code in isAllowedQualifier, not data: public is allowed only inside CREATE [OR REPLACE] VIEW ${recoverySchema}.v_ace_*

contracts.text: Boundary rule BND-6 broken: <SimpleClassName> reads public.<table>. Read recovery.<view> instead.
contracts.viewResolution: derived table-to-view map from the view bodies; several views joined with ' or '
contracts.fallback: Read a recovery.v_ace_* view instead. (derived, not in section 14)

contracts.behaviour: external: the four read-only checks against the given database; otherwise Testcontainers with fixtures. No credential in code.
